items.mainDefect: Calling to_sym on SiteSetting.default_locale in the fallback list raises NoMethodError when default_locale is nil, before compact can remove it.

secondary.defect: The incoming locale is not normalized, so the fallback list can mix String and Symbol locales. That breaks uniq and makes the @loaded_locales.include? checks miss.

items.mainDefect: The translate cache key leaves out the fallback chain and default_locale, so cached fallback results go stale when SiteSetting.default_locale changes.

secondary.defect: translate calls @loaded_locales.include? without a nil guard, so it raises NoMethodError if it runs before ensure_loaded! has set @loaded_locales.

items.mainDefect: Calling to_sym on default_locale before compact defeats the nil guard and raises when the SiteSetting is missing.

secondary.defect: The fallback list mixes String and Symbol locales when I18n.locale is a String, which breaks the fallback chain.

items.mainDefect: The method in Combat.java is public but should be private for proper encapsulation.

secondary.defect: The method has no early-return guard for when CBM.isAbleToAccessHealingItems(opponent, player) is false, so it does unnecessary processing.
